settings_rec_auto_description: Sets the default for new bills. When on, Kosha records fixed amounts on their due date. Each bill keeps its own choice.
settings_rec_coming_up_description: What the Coming up card on Overview lists.
settings_rules_learn_description: When you save a transaction, Kosha remembers its payee's category. Kosha never overwrites rules you make.
settings_rules_empty: No rules yet. Save a transaction and Kosha learns one.
settings_rules_new_hint: Saved once it has a payee and a category

match.countPlural=one: Its {count} transaction now counts as income.
match.countPlural=other: Its {count} transactions now count as income.

match.countPlural=one: Its {count} transaction now counts as spending.
match.countPlural=other: Its {count} transactions now count as spending.

settings_cat_new_hint: Saved once it has a name
settings_cat_delete_body: Nothing uses it, so nothing else changes.
settings_cat_archived_hint: Hidden from pickers; past transactions keep them
settings_cat_merge_body: Kosha moves its {items} to the category you pick, then deletes {name}. This can't be undone.
settings_api_copy_failed: Couldn’t copy. Select it and copy it yourself.
settings_api_assistants_note: In Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, add a custom connector with this URL. You’ll sign in to Kosha and choose whether it can make changes.
settings_api_mcp_description: Gives an assistant the same tools the API has: search, add, recategorise, reports.
settings_api_docs_description: Every operation with its fields and examples, from the same list the MCP tools use.
settings_api_disconnect_body: It loses access straight away. To use it again, connect it from the app and sign in.
settings_api_keys_note: For your own scripts and shortcuts. Send a key as Authorization: Bearer kosha_…. Anyone with a key can use it, so keep it secret.
settings_api_created: Copy {name} now. You won’t see it again.
settings_api_delete_body: Anything using this key stops working straight away.
settings_ai_kind_ollama: Self-hosted. Use a URL Cloudflare can reach, such as a Cloudflare Tunnel.
settings_ai_kind_compatible: Any endpoint that speaks the OpenAI API.
settings_ai_intro: Your data stays in Kosha. When a feature needs a model, Kosha sends only the fields you allow under {#b}What AI can see{/b}, to the provider you pick. It sends nothing while AI is off.
settings_ai_enabled_description: One switch for everything below. Off means no request ever leaves Kosha.
settings_ai_key_saved: Saved: …{hint}. Leave blank to keep it.
settings_ai_test_to_load: Test the connection to load models
settings_ai_url_note: Kosha calls this address from Cloudflare, not from your device.
settings_ai_key_note: Kosha stores your key encrypted on the server and never shows it again. It only sends what "What AI can see" allows.
settings_ai_categorise_description: Picks a category for a payee no rule or past entry can place. It's marked ✦ until you choose, and one tap changes it.
settings_ai_categorise_sends: The payee, and how your most-used payees are sorted.
settings_ai_quick_add_description: Type "lunch with Sam at Nando's 18.50 yesterday" in quick add, or tap ✦ on the phone add screen, and Kosha fills the form.
settings_ai_quick_add_sends: What you type, with your category names.
settings_ai_receipts_description: Amount, date and payee from a photo. Take one on the phone add screen, or paste or drop it into quick add.
settings_ai_recap_description: A short note on Overview in the first week of each month: what changed, and why.
settings_ai_recap_sends: The month's totals by category, and its largest payments.
settings_ai_ask_description: Questions about your money, answered from your data, with links to the entries behind each answer.
settings_ai_ask_sends: Only the entries each answer needs.
settings_ai_statements_description: Reads PDF statements and CSV files Kosha can't work out alone, names payees from bank text, and helps find a reconciliation difference.
settings_ai_statements_sends: The PDF you import. For a CSV, only its column names. Bank text and amounts only while What AI can see shares them.
settings_ai_needs_payee: Needs Payee names under What AI can see.
settings_ai_needs_amount: Needs Amounts under What AI can see.
settings_ai_needs_suggest: Needs Suggest a category, in General.
settings_ai_features_note: Connect a provider above, and the features you leave on start working.
settings_ai_share_payee_description: When off, Kosha sends a stable code instead.
settings_ai_share_date_description: When off, Kosha sends only the month.
settings_ai_share_note_description: Your own words. Off by default.
settings_ai_masked_note: With Payee names off, Kosha swaps each name for a stable code, so the model can still group them without knowing who they are.
settings_ai_log_description: Keeps every AI request and response for 30 days, so you can check what was sent.
settings_ai_log_dialog_description: Exactly what was sent and what came back, for the last 30 days.
settings_ai_log_empty: No requests in the last 30 days.
settings_sec_err_wrong_code: That code isn't right. Try the newest one.
settings_sec_err_too_many: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
settings_sec_err_session_old: For this, sign out and back in first.
settings_sec_err_passkey_exists: This device already has a passkey for Kosha.
settings_sec_err_last_account: You can't remove your only way to sign in.
settings_sec_checklist_description: Two minutes to finish. Each step makes your account harder to take over.
settings_sec_password_description: At least 10 characters. Changing it signs out your other devices.
settings_sec_password_description_none: You sign in without a password. Add one as a fallback.
settings_sec_passkeys_description: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key.
settings_sec_remove_body: You won't be able to sign in with it any more. Your other sign-in methods keep working.
settings_sec_google_mismatch: That Google account has a different email. Choose the one with your Kosha email.
settings_sec_google_taken: That Google account is already connected to another Kosha account.
settings_sec_google_description_none: Sign in with the Google account that has your Kosha email.
settings_sec_google_description_on: Connected. You can sign in with Google.
settings_sec_google_description_no_passw: Connected. Set a password before you disconnect it, so you can still sign in.
settings_sec_google_disconnect_body: You won't be able to sign in with Google any more. Your other sign-in methods keep working.
settings_sec_google_not_fresh: Sign out and back in, then disconnect Google.
settings_sec_two_factor_need_password: Set a password first. Two-factor protects password sign-in.
settings_sec_two_factor_on: On. Signing in with your password also asks for a code from your authenticator app.
settings_sec_two_factor_off: After your password, ask for a code from an authenticator app (1Password, Authy…).
settings_sec_enable_description: Confirm it's you. Next you'll scan a QR code with your authenticator app.
settings_sec_codes_description: Your old backup codes stop working once you get new ones.
settings_sec_disable_description: Signing in will only ask for your password. Your backup codes stop working.
settings_sec_password_mismatch: The two new passwords don't match
settings_sec_scan_description: Then type the 6-digit code it shows to finish.
settings_sec_qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
settings_sec_cant_scan: Can't scan? Enter this key instead
settings_sec_save_codes_description: If you lose your phone, each of these lets you sign in once. Kosha won't show them again.
